Looking for engaging STEM activities and science play zones for kids in Mumbai? Experience Air Alley at Playseum Children’s Museum!

At this high-energy interactive station, children learn real-world physics through unstructured play:

* Aerodynamics in Action: Twist valves and manipulate airflow to control flying scarves.
* Hands-On STEM Learning: Teaches air pressure, suction and cause-and-effect in an intuitive way.
* Safe Indoor Exploration: Part of Playseum’s 50+ interactive activities in an air-conditioned, child-friendly environment.

Turn play time into a learning adventure! 🚀✨
